meanings.en: to make a choice about something
meanings.exampleEn: I can't decide what to wear today.

meanings.en: in a deep or intense way
meanings.exampleEn: She was deeply moved by the film.

meanings.en: a unit of measurement or a university qualification
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature is thirty degrees today.

meanings.en: a period of waiting before something happens
meanings.exampleEn: There was a long delay at the airport.

meanings.en: a doctor who treats teeth
meanings.exampleEn: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.

meanings.en: a large shop selling many kinds of goods
meanings.exampleEn: We bought new clothes at the department store.

meanings.en: to be affected or decided by something else
meanings.exampleEn: Our plans depend on the weather.

meanings.en: words that tell you what something is like
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a detailed description of the thief.

meanings.en: a large dry area of land with little water
meanings.exampleEn: Camels can survive in the desert for days.

meanings.en: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
meanings.exampleEn: We had ice cream for dessert.

meanings.en: to damage something so badly it cannot be used
meanings.exampleEn: The fire destroyed the old building.

meanings.en: a small piece of information about something
meanings.exampleEn: Please tell me every detail of the story.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bana hikâyenin her ayrıntısını anlat.

meanings.en: to grow or make something grow or improve
meanings.exampleEn: The company wants to develop new products.

meanings.en: having advanced industry and technology
meanings.exampleEn: Japan is a highly developed country.

meanings.en: a very hard, clear precious stone
meanings.exampleEn: Her ring has a beautiful diamond.

meanings.en: a book where you write what happens each day
meanings.exampleEn: She writes in her diary every night.

meanings.en: to stop living
meanings.exampleEn: The plant will die without water.

meanings.en: the food you usually eat, or eating less to lose weight
meanings.exampleEn: A healthy diet is important for everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Sağlıklı bir beslenme düzeni herkes için önemlidir.

meanings.en: in a way that is not the same
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone thinks differently about this issue.

meanings.en: a problem or something hard to do
meanings.exampleEn: He had difficulty finding the address.

meanings.en: a camera that stores photos electronically
meanings.exampleEn: I took the photos with my digital camera.

meanings.en: a large reptile that lived millions of years ago
meanings.exampleEn: The museum has a huge dinosaur skeleton.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzede kocaman bir dinozor iskeleti var.

meanings.en: going straight without stopping or changing
meanings.exampleEn: Is there a direct flight to Rome?

meanings.en: the way someone or something moves or faces
meanings.exampleEn: We walked in the wrong direction.

meanings.en: a person who manages a company or a film
meanings.exampleEn: She is the director of a big company.

meanings.en: something that makes a situation worse or harder
meanings.exampleEn: One disadvantage of the job is the long hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu işin bir dezavantajı uzun çalışma saatleri.

meanings.en: to have a different opinion from someone
meanings.exampleEn: I disagree with your decision.

meanings.en: to go away so it cannot be seen
meanings.exampleEn: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

meanings.en: sad because something was not as good as you hoped
meanings.exampleEn: She was disappointed with her exam results.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınav sonuçları yüzünden hayal kırıklığına uğradı.

meanings.en: not as good as you hoped or expected
meanings.exampleEn: The movie was very disappointing.

meanings.en: a place or event where people dance to music
meanings.exampleEn: We danced all night at the disco.

meanings.en: to find something for the first time
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists discovered a new planet.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları yeni bir gezegen keşfetti.

meanings.en: a talk about something with other people
meanings.exampleEn: We had a long discussion about the plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Plan hakkında uzun bir görüşme yaptık.

meanings.en: not honest; likely to lie or cheat
meanings.exampleEn: It is wrong to be dishonest with your friends.

meanings.en: a feeling of not liking something
meanings.exampleEn: She has a strong dislike of spiders.
meanings.exampleTr: Örümceklere karşı güçlü bir hoşlanmaması var.

meanings.en: an arrangement of things for people to see
meanings.exampleEn: There was a beautiful display of flowers in the shop.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkânda güzel bir çiçek sergisi vardı.

meanings.en: to interrupt or bother someone
meanings.exampleEn: Please don't disturb me while I'm working.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ben çalışırken beni rahatsız etme.

meanings.en: feeling that things are turning around you
meanings.exampleEn: I felt dizzy after the long flight.

meanings.en: finished or completed (past participle of do)
meanings.exampleEn: I have done all my homework.

meanings.en: twice as much or having two parts
meanings.exampleEn: We booked a double room at the hotel.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelde çift kişilik bir oda ayırttık.

meanings.en: a feeling of not being sure about something
meanings.exampleEn: There is no doubt that she is right.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun haklı olduğuna hiç şüphe yok.

meanings.en: to or in the central part of a city
meanings.exampleEn: We went downtown to do some shopping.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışveriş yapmak için şehir merkezine gittik.

meanings.en: a game result in which neither side wins
meanings.exampleEn: The match ended in a draw.

meanings.en: a sliding box in a desk or piece of furniture
meanings.exampleEn: The socks are in the top drawer.

meanings.en: a picture made with a pen or pencil
meanings.exampleEn: She made a beautiful drawing of a horse.

meanings.en: wearing clothes
meanings.exampleEn: He got dressed quickly and left.

meanings.en: a tool used for making holes
meanings.exampleEn: He used a drill to make a hole in the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarda delik açmak için matkap kullandı.

meanings.en: an official document that allows you to drive
meanings.exampleEn: You need a driver's license to drive a car.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba kullanmak için ehliyete ihtiyacın var.

meanings.en: a very small amount of liquid
meanings.exampleEn: A drop of rain fell on my hand.

meanings.en: a medicine, or an illegal substance
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor gave me a new drug for my cough.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor öksürüğüm için bana yeni bir ilaç verdi.

meanings.en: a shop selling medicines and other goods
meanings.exampleEn: I bought some aspirin at the drugstore.

meanings.en: a water bird with a wide beak and short legs
meanings.exampleEn: The children fed the ducks in the park.

meanings.en: tiny dry particles of dirt in the air or on surfaces
meanings.exampleEn: There was a lot of dust on the old books.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kitapların üzerinde çok toz vardı.

meanings.en: before the usual or expected time
meanings.exampleEn: I woke up early this morning.

meanings.en: to get money for work you do
meanings.exampleEn: She earns a good salary at her job.

meanings.en: a piece of jewellery worn on the ear
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a pair of gold earrings.

meanings.en: the planet we live on; also soil
meanings.exampleEn: The earth goes around the sun.

meanings.en: a sudden shaking of the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The earthquake destroyed many houses.

meanings.en: without difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: He passed the exam easily.

meanings.en: in or toward the direction where the sun rises
meanings.exampleEn: They live on the east side of the city.

meanings.en: a person who prepares texts for publication
meanings.exampleEn: The editor checked the article carefully.

meanings.en: the process of teaching and learning
meanings.exampleEn: Education is very important for children.

meanings.en: providing or relating to education
meanings.exampleEn: The trip to the museum was very educational.

meanings.en: a change caused by something
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine had a quick effect.

meanings.en: the energy you use to do something
meanings.exampleEn: He made a big effort to finish on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Zamanında bitirmek için büyük çaba gösterdi.

meanings.en: old, used politely about people
meanings.exampleEn: We should help elderly people cross the street.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı insanların karşıdan karşıya geçmesine yardım etmeliyiz.

meanings.en: using or producing electricity
meanings.exampleEn: We bought a new electric kettle.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni bir elektrikli su ısıtıcısı aldık.

meanings.en: a very large grey animal with a long trunk
meanings.exampleEn: The elephant drank water with its trunk.

meanings.en: a machine that carries people between floors
meanings.exampleEn: We took the elevator to the tenth floor.

meanings.en: in or to another place
meanings.exampleEn: If they are closed, we can eat elsewhere.
meanings.exampleTr: Eğer kapalılarsa başka bir yerde yiyebiliriz.
